instructions.review_unit: one observation and its exact observation-local text from the manifest
instructions.evidence_rule: Use only the observation_local_text and evidence_provenance in the manifest. Do not use current entity fields to fill historical gaps.
instructions.missing_text_rule: Mark source_evidence_sufficient=false and leave classification.label null when no usable local text is present; do not guess from an empty input.
instructions.mention_rule: List each product mention once. Span offsets are zero-based Python Unicode code-point indexes with an exclusive end, measured against the exact observation_local_text. Keep the span to the shortest evidenced identifying phrase; do not include unrelated marketing copy or UI text.
instructions.sufficiency_rule: Set sufficiently_evidenced=false when the text does not support that mention; use UNKNOWN classification if the record type itself is not defensible.
instructions.identity_rule: Only enter known_alias or canonical_product_identity when independently verifiable. Use REVIEW for unresolved ambiguity/conflict and UNMAPPED when no defensible catalog identity is available. Never invent a canonical ID.
instructions.unreviewed_values: Null means not reviewed. After review, mentions=[] means reviewed and no product mention was found.
